definitions.explanation: The number of votes a candidate or party receives in an election.

examples.japanese: {得票|とくひょう}{数|すう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}→発表：03562_happyou⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{最|もっと}も→最も：01736_mottomo⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{得票|とくひょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{得|え}た→得る：02014_eru⟧。
⟦{前回|ぜんかい}→前回：11817_zenkai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{選挙|せんきょ}→選挙：03303_senkyo⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{比|くら}べて→比べる：01237_kuraberu⟧{得票|とくひょう}{率|りつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{下|さ}がった→下がる：01188_sagaru⟧。
examples.english: Compared to the last election, the vote share dropped significantly.

notes:
{得票|とくひょう} refers to votes received by a candidate or party. The focus is on the receiving side of voting.

FORMS:
⟦{得|とく}→得：12563_toku⟧ (to obtain/gain) + ⟦{票|ひょう}→票：03582_hyou⟧ (vote/ballot)

COMPOUNDS:
- {得票|とくひょう}{数|すう}: number of votes obtained
- {得票|とくひょう}{率|りつ}: vote share, percentage of votes
- {得票|とくひょう}⟦{差|さ}→差：02771_sa⟧: margin of votes

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{投票|とうひょう}→投票：03453_touhyou⟧: the act of casting a ballot (voter's side)
- {得票|とくひょう}: votes received (candidate's side)

Used primarily in election reporting and political contexts. Often appears in news coverage of ⟦{選挙|せんきょ}→選挙：03303_senkyo⟧ (elections).
